decision: captured baseline on trunk main before touching anything
why: so every later check is old value vs new value

decision: isolated work in a git worktree off main instead of switching the user's dirty branch
why: their working tree had unrelated WIP I must not clobber

decision: split target into M1 SPA-parity-on-Next and M2 SSR/RSC
why: the full migration is multi-session and SSR/RSC depends on a working Next shell

decision: scaffolded Next 16 App Router, proved the build works with React Compiler, Turbopack, Tailwind, strict TS, and prerender
why: riskiest unknown first, cheap to fail

decision: renamed src/pages to src/views because Next reserves the pages directory name
why: foundational naming decision, cheap now, rewrite later

decision: switched build globals to NEXT_PUBLIC_* because Next rejects __-prefixed env keys
why: the Vite define trick has no Next equivalent

decision: wrote a single navigation adapter over next/navigation instead of touching every component
why: boundary discipline, one place for framework churn
result: 21 routers importers reduced to 9 adapter call sites

decision: mocked next/navigation with a self-contained store instead of keeping react-router for tests
why: exactly the compatibility crutch outcome-oriented execution warns against

decision: verified every route on the real next dev server with a browser, no hydration error after the ThemeProvider fix
why: prove-it-works against the artifact, not the build log

decision: moved CSP to nonce middleware and forced dynamic rendering; a static page cannot carry a per-request nonce so production scripts would be blocked
why: proved it: static output showed nonce "$undefined", dynamic output injects the nonce
result: no CSP violation on app scripts, no hydration error

decision: deleted vite/react-router entrypoints and deps, moved vitest to its own config
why: converge on the target architecture, no dual-framework state left
result: 62 files, 675 tests, lint, next build green

decision: updated AGENTS.md and README.md, recorded the screenshot-helper port and server-data-fetching as known follow-ups
why: keep the docs honest about what still runs

decision: hydration mismatch on seeded localStorage broke 17 e2e tests; deferred every storage read to a mount effect
why: found the real cause instead of disabling SSR; the mismatch is why pages rendered empty

decision: the harness navigated with a manual pushState plus popstate, a react-router trick Next ignores
why: Next's router owns history; a raw pushState does not navigate

decision: final gate: 675 unit tests, lint, next build, 49 e2e all green against the real dev server
why: prove the whole against the predicate, not the build log

decision: left two known follow-ups: PR screenshot scripts still call vite build, and public reads remain client-side
why: be honest about what still runs; server data fetching is the remaining M2 work

decision: correction: baseline was 680 tests on trunk, final is 675; deleted App.test (4) and sanity.test (1) because App and the react-router wiring they covered no longer exist
why: the audit flagged the drift; account for it rather than leave it implicit
result: -5 explained, route wiring now covered by e2e

decision: correction: src/lib/supabase.ts now returns null on the server instead of throwing at import

decision: correction: useMe now verifies identity from a mount effect, not render-time initialData

decision: deliberately left the API bearer token as NEXT_PUBLIC_ (client-visible)
